race.comment: PRAY TELL (4) looks the clear horse to beat, resuming for the Freedman yard after showing good ability in two heavy-track runs last campaign. His Sandown-Lakeside debut second reads well for this and two trial wins since, including one at Cranbourne two weeks ago, suggest he is ready to produce fresh. Connections of the other horses see it similarly with a few key scratchings leaving him very short. Of the rest, PLINIAN (10) didn't fire last start at Echuca but had been close up prior and can place. YOUMANETIC (6) just found one better on debut at Kilmore and will give them something to catch. BERADO (7) best of the rest.
